question: Does a California-wide search recover the published Livermore area for N784MB_R04?
mode: Assisted observed-curve plus original-spectrogram scoring; not an end-to-end automatic detection test.
inputs: UTC frequency measurements from the source CSV
All usable aircraft tracks from the independent May 14 archive in a padded California bounding box from 17:39 to 17:46 UTC
California state mask, terrain and EGM96 geoid
withheld_from_scoring: Published speed, distance and height result table
known_utc_assumption: Published CSV UTC timestamps are approximately correct; WAV alignment is inferred only from recorded frequency content. +/-5 s shared clock search.
coarse_search_limitations: Single-event corridor search uses acoustic-derived speed and maximum-slant bounds; coarse spectral/shape rejection can miss subcell fits. Only up to eight competing flight/spatial peaks are refined per stage.
silence: No silence constraints: no separately reviewed silent interval. Separate files are not treated as one continuous multi-event recording.

execution_partition.reason: Full-state flight-corridor grid exceeds two-million-point per-run limit.
execution_partition.coverage: Three contiguous latitude bands spanning the original full California bounds; every band retains California polygon mask and 200 m spacing.
